notes.title: Paper Nebula Update!
notes.content:
First Major Paper Nebula Update!

Updates include:
1. Holding the fire button now causes the main weapons to fire continuously. (A much requested feature.)
2. Destruction counter added to the save screen.
3. Minor changes to the text dialogue with the A.I. 
4. The drone launch button is now disabled during conversations. Avoiding mis-clicks that skip the dialogue.
5. Minor text corrections.

notes.title: Paper Nebula is out on the 20th of October!
notes.content:
Get ready because Paper Nebula is out in only 1 week!
That's really soon!

To prepare make sure:

 Your paper plane piloting skills are on point. 
 You have your favorite game controller handy.
 You have Wishlisted the game!

Vela needs your help, don't leave her trapped with only a snaky A.I. companion forever!!!

Releasing October 20!
